name: p31-spaceship-earth
description: P31 Spaceship Earth MCP Server — Dome geometry, system health, DUNA readiness, PQC operations (Ed25519, ML-DSA-65, ML-KEM-768), EUDI Wallet VC 2.1 export, session management, semantic search, mesh networking. 16 tools.

tools.name: duna_status
tools.description: Get DUNA readiness: member count vs target, progress bar, readiness label, and active ships. Read-only.

tools.name: system_health
tools.description: Get system health: coherence, spoons, engagement, docked ports, and mesh status. Read-only.

tools.name: dome_structure
tools.description: Get the docking-dome geometry facts: layers, mode, radius, outer edges, ports, NeoPixel segments, K4 tetra frame, inner dome. Read-only.

tools.name: neo_pixel_control
tools.description: Set the NeoPixel LED controller state (mode, speed, color, brightness). Validated and persisted to the spaceship state file.

tools.name: pqc_keygen
tools.description: Generate an Ed25519 or ML-DSA-65 hybrid keypair for post-quantum signing.

tools.name: pqc_sign
tools.description: Sign data with Ed25519 or ML-DSA-65. Returns hex-encoded signature.

tools.name: pqc_verify
tools.description: Verify Ed25519 or ML-DSA-65 signature against data.

tools.name: kem_encapsulate
tools.description: Hybrid KEM encapsulate: ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) + X25519. Returns shared secret and ciphertext.

tools.name: kem_decapsulate
tools.description: Hybrid KEM decapsulate: ML-KEM-768 + X25519. Returns shared secret.

tools.name: eudi_export
tools.description: Export a W3C Verifiable Credential (VC 2.1) for the current spaceship-earth session or dome state. Returns a JSON VC ready for EUDI Wallet import.

tools.name: eudi_verify
tools.description: Verify a W3C Verifiable Credential (VC 2.1) against its issuer DID. Returns validity status.

tools.name: session_list
tools.description: List recent spaceship-earth sessions from the local sessions directory.

tools.name: session_export
tools.description: Export a session record as a verifiable credential or JSON.

tools.name: embedding_store
tools.description: Store a text embedding for semantic search over session history. Uses a local vector store.

tools.name: embedding_search
tools.description: Semantic search over stored embeddings. Returns top-k most similar texts.

tools.name: mesh_peers
tools.description: List known mesh peers from the local peer registry.

tools.name: mesh_sync_status
tools.description: Get mesh synchronization status: last sync, peer count, pending ops.
